text: Day seven. The hardest day. The average Indian spends about five hours a day on a phone. That's five hours you now have to fill. Every single day. The metro feels longer. The lift feels longer. Even the bathroom feels longer. {deadpan} You start reading shampoo bottles. {neutral} But slowly, something else creeps in. You look up. You notice your own street. You finish a whole conversation without checking anything. {warm} Quick question. What's the first thing you'd do with five free hours a day? Tell me in the comments.
